The Los Angeles Lakers are an American professional basketball team.
The Lakers compete in the National Basketball Association (NBA).
The Lakers play their home games at Crypto.com Arena, which they share with other teams.
The franchise began as the Detroit Gems of the National Basketball League (NBL) in 1946.
After one season, the team was relocated to Minneapolis and renamed the Minneapolis Lakers.
The Lakers won the 1948 NBL championship before joining the rival Basketball Association of America (BAA).
Following the merger of the NBL and BAA into the NBA in 1949, the Lakers won four of the next five NBA championships.
After struggling financially in the late 1950s, they relocated to Los Angeles for the 1960–61 season.
The Lakers made the NBA Finals six times in the 1960s but lost every series to the Celtics.
In 1968, Wilt Chamberlain joined the team and helped them win their sixth NBA title in 1972.
After the retirement of Chamberlain, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar was traded for and became a star player.
Jerry Buss purchased the Lakers and introduced a vision of basketball as entertainment.
In 1980, Magic Johnson was drafted first overall and led the team to five championships with Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.
The Lakers won their 16th title in 2010 against the Boston Celtics.
Kobe Bryant played for the Lakers from 1996 until his retirement in 2016.
LeBron James signed a four-year, $154 million contract with the Lakers on July 9, 2018.
The Lakers acquired Anthony Davis in a trade that ended the young core era of the team.
In 2020, the Lakers won their 17th championship against the Miami Heat.
LeBron James was named Finals MVP for the fourth time in his career.
The Lakers have 39 Hall-of-Famers who contributed to the organization.
The Lakers retired thirteen jersey numbers and honored Michael Cooper with an honorary microphone.
Chick Hearn broadcast 3,338 consecutive games from November 21, 1965, until his death in 2002.
Bill Macdonald became the new television play-by-play announcer for the 2011–12 season.
The Lakers have a long-standing relationship with KCAL-TV as their over-the-air broadcaster since 1977.
